steps: Identify installed amplifier RF module,DSIM model/part number,firmware and interface used.
Select the exact applicable manual revision; station housing brand alone is insufficient.
Record job-approved output levels,slope,frequencies,measurement plane and meter test-point compensation. No manufacturer maximum is substituted for a local target.

sgGHPhysicalController.scope: Only installed DSIM-SG/station configuration confirmed applicable to RevG/H.

steps.text: Set S1 manual(position2). At maximum gain,use the backoff applicable to the documented test frequency:3.2dB at547MHz,4.1dB at750MHz,or4.6dB at870MHz. Select S1position3,AGC pad0dB,then set design input/output.
Connect240330-01 and controller.Wait for synchronization; confirm solid-blueMGC before adjusting levels.

Outside40–80°F,record highest-frequency RF output,apply the manual controller output adjustment below,then restore that recorded output using the input pad. Do not extrapolate the table or translate raw app counts into dB.
Choose verified upfront cable factor9/18/27dB and confirm its LED pattern. TGC for pedestal/underground installation is discouraged by the manual.

Return to solid-blueMGC and verify output/slope. PressMode once,wait about45seconds for alignment,and confirm blinking-blueAGC and intended pilot/type. Resolve failed alignment; do not leave setup in failure fallback.

controllerTemperatureTable.quantity: RF output adjustment using physical controller; input pad restores original recorded output afterward
controllerTemperatureTable.frequency: Highest operating frequency recorded before adjustment
controllerTemperatureTable.boundaryNote: Confirm exactly20,40,80,100°F boundary handling under local/manufacturer procedure; the printed ranges share boundaries. No automated boundary acceptance.
controllerTemperatureTable.erratum: Printed40°F Celsius label in one cold row is incorrect;40°F=+4.4°C,not−4.4°C.

sgGHPhysicalController.retryNote: Source describes reducing AGC pad by3dB after pilot-lock failure,but initialG/Hpad0dB cannot be reduced as an ordinary nonnegative pad. Do not generate a negative pad; verify actual installed pad/pilot path and obtain applicable guidance.
sourceConflicts: RevE pad and temperature recipe differs.
SG fault-voltage table conflicts with model-specific data sheet; show conflict instead of threshold.
Quick-start text omits some temperature/fallback details; use full procedure.

mobileApp.scope: Manufacturer app guideRevB; installed app and module firmware must be checked separately.

steps.text: Use specifiedDSIM-DONGLE-02Bluetooth4.0 interface and verify the intended localDSIM connection.
Record serial/firmware and current attenuation/min/center/max. Attenuator center is associated with near68°F in this guide; raw position is not dB.
UseWorkingModeMGC for manual setup.AGCPrep controls return the module toMGC if another mode was active.

AGCPrep minus decreases attenuation(cold setup);plus increases attenuation(hot setup);zero returns center.MAX/MIN are for finding range only.The guide gives no universal raw-count-to-dB or number-of-clicks recipe.
Confirm the approved pilot/type/key inACI app.Then enterAGC and wait until its process finishes before closing the app.
Record chosen log interval;changes apply to future collected samples.Save relevant data/event logs with the job.

mobileApp.signWarning: The app documents attenuation changes;the physical controller documents RF output changes.Keep labels distinct and verify measured effect;do not combine their numeric recipes.

historicalA.scope: HistoricalDSIM-Aonly;exact installed applicability must be confirmed.1218-MHzMDL-1201 remains unverified.

steps.text: If fitting the module,install with power off per this manual.For a new station,power on and allow about20minutes warm-up.
Attach controller,wait for sync,and confirm solid-blueMGC.Set design level/slope using input pad/EQ.
Use only the applicable historicalA temperature preparation and fallback instructions;these are not theGainMakerSGS1/backoff/pad recipe.
Start alignment fromMGC;wait about45seconds and confirmAGCblink and pilot.Evaluate final measured levels against job requirements.

closeout.basis: Engineering workflow recommendation,not additional manufacturer specification
steps: Record final mode,pilot frequency/type,firmware,cable factor and applied pad/EQ values.
Measure final output levels/slope at named frequencies and planes;verify approved job limits,not checked-step counts.
Verify normal pilot lock and resolve warnings.Save original meter evidence and relevantDSIMlogs.
After housing closure/thermal settling,recheck under applicable station procedure.Do not apply historicalA thermal-rise numbers universally.
